06

Stay with
the detail.

There is no single scale for good work. Sometimes the useful next step is a better question. Sometimes it is a replacement part.

01

Observe

Look at the system and listen to the person. Start with what is known, and keep the uncertainty visible.

02

Investigate

Trace the symptom. Read the evidence. Work across the boundaries of software, hardware and infrastructure.

03

Explain

Verify what changed. Document what helped. Give the next person a clear place to start.
